value.rationale: Backup redundancy is intrinsic to the paired-domination security model: matched partners provide alternatives. The exact bivariate count resolves every subset size and number of available perfect matching assignments, beyond the ordinary polynomial that conflates differently redundant subsets. Its Fibonacci trichotomy for distinct hub configurations, configurations with unique pairing, and all selected pairing witnesses establishes a sharp limiting fraction 1/phi of configurations with no backup choice and mean phi admissible pairings. This is a natural structural classification for an entire labelled wheel family; not just an arbitrary finite count or renaming.
